dedupe_keys.name: electricgrid jl power electronic grid simulator

description: ElectricGrid.jl is a Julia toolbox for time-domain simulation of electricity grids with power-electronic converters. Users assemble component-level state-space models and configure controls; the software advances grid states and can generate synthetic trajectories for comparing control methods. The network size, geographic interpretation and simulation duration come from the user’s component configuration, not a built-in utility system. Its public repository, Julia package instructions and examples are MIT licensed. It can support studies of converter controls, grid disturbances and interactions between distributed sources. A caveat is that a model assembled from generic components needs parameter evidence and network validation before conclusions about a specific feeder. The article demonstrates model setup but does not make every possible converter configuration reliable. No directly related catalogue record was established. The JOSS summary, own source and README were read without running a grid transient.
